title.zh: 浮与沉 · 排开的水托住了谁
title.en: Float & Sink · What the Displaced Water Holds Up

description.zh: 浮力等于排开的水的重量；平均密度小于水则浮。理想不可压缩水，忽略表面张力与翻覆稳定性。
description.en: Buoyant force equals the weight of the displaced water; an object floats if its average density is below water's. Ideal incompressible water; surface tension and tipping stability ignored.

label.en: Floating is decided by the net force

reason.zh: 重力向下、浮力向上，二者之差是合力：合力为零时物体在该位置保持静止（浮着），不为零就上浮或下沉。
reason.en: Weight pulls down and buoyancy pushes up; their difference is the net force: zero means the object rests (floats) there, otherwise it rises or sinks.

title.zh: 为什么橡皮泥捏成船就能浮？
title.en: Why does plasticine float once shaped into a boat?
